journey.name: Lift: an easier day
journey.description: After a session that felt very hard, Lift's next session on the program offers an easier day before its first set. Run on a fresh install with a bell owned.

actions.action: On Train's Strength pillar, tap "Follow a program", find "20 minutes beside BJJ", open it and tap "Follow this program"
Start a session, log a set, tap "Finish", pick "Very hard" under "How was it?" and tap "Done"

Tap "Start day 1" and verify that a card "Easier today" says "Your last session felt very hard, and it was a day and a half ago at most", "Presses and squats a bell lighter, swings and snatches shorter, rests by the lift" and "Day 2 of this program is the lighter one on the grip", with "Use it"
Tap "Use it" and verify that the card goes and Up next counts 12 sets of the Armor Building Complex, not 15
